confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from third-party cost-of-living and travel-guide aggregators that disagree with each other, not from venue menus, so they are bounded estimates. Beer, coffee and restaurant meals are the better-supported anchors. Wine is inferred from Auckland price tables, and cocktail is inferred from a single aggregator benchmark. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the Oceania/Wellington context; no accommodation searches were run and no live listings were checked. The NZD-to-USD conversion uses an assumed rate of about 0.58, which was not searched. The FX observation came from a search-result summary of the RBA exchange-rate feed (18 Nov 2026) and was not read directly from rba.gov.au, so verify it before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced directly against New Zealand guide data for Wellington (NZD), with Auckland restaurant, bar and wine tables used as a rough cross-check for wine and cocktails. Wellington is described as slightly cheaper than Auckland overall. Accommodation is a holistic estimate from general knowledge of mid-sized New Zealand cities with a strong visitor season.
